name: USB Wi-Fi Hotspot (EV6 KR)
description: The hotspot wireless CarPlay joins on a Korean EV6 without a Wi-Fi chip: a USB Wi-Fi dongle (RTL8812BU/RTL8822BU) on the stock CarPlay SSID and password, with its own driver (GPL-2.0, modules/SOURCE.txt), the stock hostapd and dnsmasq. Needs no usbwifi.hotspot (stays off while that is installed).
